items.criterion: A draft project is absent from every public list, in the pages and in the API alike.
items.judgment: Read the public project list as an anonymous caller and as a reader, and compare against the rows an editor sees.

items.criterion: A draft project's image object is refused by the store to a caller with no credential.
items.judgment: Fetch the draft cover's object key straight from the store with no credential.

items.criterion: Every published project's cover bytes are in the bucket at the key its row records.
items.judgment: Walk every published project, read its image rows and confirm each key exists in the bucket.

items.criterion: The digest an image row records is the digest of the bytes the store holds.
items.judgment: Fetch each stored object and compare its hash with the digest on the row.

items.criterion: One enquiry message produces one stored row however many times the submission repeats.
items.judgment: Submit one enquiry payload twice and count the rows.

items.criterion: An enquiry is stored with a unique twelve-character reference.
items.judgment: Send an enquiry, read the reference and confirm its shape and its uniqueness.

items.criterion: A reader is denied at every editorial write with the rows unchanged.
items.judgment: Call each editorial write as a reader and compare the stored project row before and after.

items.criterion: An unauthenticated caller is denied on every studio route.
items.judgment: Call the studio endpoints with no token and open the studio routes signed out.

items.criterion: The public project list returns the ten published projects in their order.
items.judgment: Read the public list and compare its titles and its order field against the seed.

items.criterion: Publishing flips the flag, records when, and puts the project into the public list.
items.judgment: Create a project, publish it and re-read the public list.

items.criterion: An invalid enquiry is refused as a client error naming the field at fault, writing nothing.
items.judgment: Submit an enquiry with each field in turn made invalid and count the rows.

items.criterion: An unknown address answers not found under an honest document title.
items.judgment: Request an address that exists nowhere and read the status beside the title.

items.criterion: Every internal link on every public route resolves.
items.judgment: Collect every internal link from every public route and request each one.

items.criterion: Seeding the app a second time duplicates no account, project, team member or office.
items.judgment: Count each seeded collection after the app has started.

items.criterion: The eight legal chapters are numbered and titled exactly as the brief pins them.
items.judgment: Read the legal collection and compare each number and title against the pinned eight.

items.criterion: The project index opens in the List arrangement.
items.judgment: Open the index cold and read which of the three options is marked current.

items.criterion: Body text against its background meets the accessibility contrast bar.
items.judgment: Read the computed colours of the body text and its ground, then compute the ratio.

items.criterion: Nothing overflows sideways at the narrowest declared width.
items.judgment: Load each public route at the narrow viewport and compare the scroll width with the client width.
